findings.where: meta line 'Tw93 Open Source Family' (#8e9db3 on #1B365D)
findings.evidence: Computed 4.40:1 at 30 px regular on the 1242 canvas; it passes as large text on the full-size image but once the card is viewed in a feed (about 2.8x smaller, SOC-109) it becomes ~11 px text at 4.4:1, below the 4.5:1 normal-text threshold.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum), applied at viewing size for a phone-viewed canvas.

findings.evidence: alt="Mole menu bar status panel" names the image but not what it tells; when posted, the platform alt text should carry the key facts the card shows.
findings.after: alt="Mole's menu bar panel: health score 100, CPU 14%, memory 72%, disk 292 GB free, battery 80%, top processes by memory"; reuse as the post's alt text

strengths: Title (10.7:1) and tagline (7.0:1) have strong contrast on the ink ground.
All text is live text with lang="en", and the single image has an alt.
not_investigated: focus order, keyboard, forms, reflow: not applicable to a fixed 1242x1660 social canvas
the exported image's alt text on the posting platform is outside this artefact
